headline: INEC removes 1.6 million invalid names from voter register
ticker: BREAKING · INEC cleans voter register · 1,608,660 invalid records removed · 54 officials flagged · 9jaBeacon · www.9jabeacon.name.ng

narration.text: Good evening from the 9jaBeacon desk. INEC says it has removed one point six million invalid names from the voter register ahead of 2027, and identified fifty-four registration officials across ten states for possible disciplinary action.
